image_description: A landscape photograph featuring three bison in a dry, grassy field. One bison is prominent in the foreground left, facing forward with visible horns and head. Another bison is in the foreground right, grazing with its head down, showing its hump and hindquarters. A third bison is visible in the mid-ground left, walking laterally. The background features rolling hills and sparse vegetation under a bright sky.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Large broad head with short curved horns.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The foreground left bison clearly displays a large, broad head with characteristic short, curved horns. The anatomy matches the species description.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Beard of long hair on chin and throat.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Visible on the foreground left bison; there is distinct shaggy hair hanging from the chin/throat area.
The eye of the foreground left bison is visible and appears dark, consistent with the checkpoint.
Ears are not prominently sticking out; they appear small and nestled within the thick fur of the head, matching the description.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Massive body with exceptionally tall, heavily built proportions at the withers.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: All visible bison exhibit the characteristic massive build and high withers/shoulder hump typical of the species.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Shaggy dark brown fur covering forequarters forming prominent shoulder hump.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The texture is visibly shaggy and dark brown, particularly dense around the shoulders and head, forming the iconic hump.
Comparing the foreground right bison's rear to its front, the fur on the hindquarters appears smoother and less voluminous than the forequarters.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Short horns compared to body size.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The horns are relatively short and curved, proportional to the massive size of the animal's head and body.
The legs are mostly obscured by tall grass. While the upper legs look sturdy, the hooves are completely hidden from view, making this checkpoint untestable.
The tail of the mid-ground bison is visible and shows the characteristic short length with a bushy end. The foreground right bison's tail is also partially visible.

artifact_observations.location: Foreground grass and bison fur interface
artifact_observations.reasoning: Slight 'painterly' or smudged texture in the grass immediately surrounding the bison's legs and body. The boundary between the fur and the grass lacks crisp micro-contrast, suggesting minor generative blending issues.

The legs of the bison in the middle distance appear somewhat indistinct and merge slightly with the ground plane. While partly due to resolution/depth of field, the anatomical definition of the lower legs is weaker than expected for a sharp photo, hinting at AI generation artifacts in complex occlusion areas.

To verify the structural integrity of the limbs and head orientation, ensuring no extra limbs or warped anatomy.
To audit the boundary between the shaggy fur and the background/grass for edge bleeding or fusion artifacts.
To assess global coherence, lighting consistency, and detect subtle texture anomalies across the scene.
